digest.component_or_area: plan review Pass-1 criterion and container sibling-roster infrastructure
propositions: Plan review certifies plans whose acceptance criteria are mutually unsatisfiable (contradictions between AC, Scope, and Out-of-Scope); no single-turn criterion currently owns detection of joint satisfiability, leaving the gap for late discovery.

Three independent copies of sibling roster-building expressions exist in pass1.py, fidelity_spot_eval.py, and eval_solver.py; they must be unified into a single shared builder to ensure consistent AC-item inclusion across production and eval paths.

G3's child-coverage audit cannot discharge its "no sibling covers it" test because it receives only child ids and titles, not their acceptance criteria; the audit silences itself every time despite having a live verifier axis (internal_conflict) to ground the finding.

The sibling roster is currently sent repeated in per-pairing instructions, making it uncacheable and quadratic in cost with child count; it must move to a byte-stable system-prompt prefix and be counted in the parent_tokens estimate.
A child description with no Acceptance Criteria section or a parent with no children must degrade gracefully (empty roster entry or empty roster) rather than raising.
